goal: Let a reviewer or judge come from another model family even inside Claude Code, so R42 and R43 can be judged by a model other than the candidates' (roadmap R11, chosen by Beau in HUMAN_TASKS H17).
changed: beau-mode gains scripts/second_opinion.py: --reviewer cli:<agent>:<model> --prompt-file FILE [--cwd DIR] [--timeout SECONDS] [--json] sends one read-only prompt to claude or cursor-agent and returns status ok, empty, error, timeout or missing. Its contract is references/second-opinion.md.
The roles snippet, in every skill that names roles, says a cli: entry runs through that script and not as a subagent, that it only reads, and what to do when it gives no answer.
HUMAN_TASKS H17 records Beau's answer (a judge for R42 and R43 only, through R11) with the judge model still open. R11 is marked done, and R42 and R43 now depend on R11 and that model.
